Why doesn't Voat allow multiple ID's?

Comes from back when voat was being built. Since the place was new, admins didn't want folks making uber-multiple user accounts that could be used to game the system. They didn't want another unidan or gallowboob showing up and putting "their" content at the top-sort by using alts to up the voat count.

The system of restricting one UA to each IP has never been presented as a permanent solution, but someone else may explain what possibilities are being examined as the 1IP=1UA situation is bad. If my network uses NAT, every PC that tries to create a UA is seen as 1 IP address to the Internet. So the first person to make a voat account (that would be me!) is ok, but anyone else will get denied.
